service.description: Refuses (RESPONSE_LOCKED) when the response answers a FormInvitation, which keeps it as submitted; the FormPublication.eecas.xml rules run the same check before every write of a response and its answers, so org.moqui.impl.ScreenServices.update#FormResponse and delete#FormResponse refuse such a response. A response with no invitation passes.

impl-people P16: the editor of a published form (its purpose's edit permission and organization, mantle.party.FormDefinitions) offers it from now with an access kind (FpaInvited by default, FpaAnonymous, FpaAccount) its purpose's registration admits (mantle.party.FormPurpose accessEnumIds), for the registered publication purpose; refused PUBLICATION_NOT_OFFERED for a kind the purpose does not admit, so a form of a private purpose (People's) is never published to anyone, FORM_NOT_PUBLISHED before its questions are. Once per form and access kind while open. Marketing's publication services build on it (impl-marketing P12).
